message:
docs(release): record 0.2.148 and APK 0.2.25 -- the wire cap

history.md: the 0.2.148 / APK 0.2.25 entry -- what 0.2.147 did with a 6 Mbps setting, the agreed
contract (one wire limiter for data, FEC, NACK and headers; every UDP peer; progress-based NACK
tail), the r1..r9 rounds and the approved product source 152b685, the verifier's independent runs
and what the paired event-ID measurement does and does not show, the real-receiver smoke and its
intermittent observation fault, the release evidence and Codex's own external check.
작업목록.md: deployed versions, C0 stays open (the hard cap is in; estimate-driven ABR and UI are
not), V11 for APK 0.2.25, V14 narrowed to cancel/large/bar, V15 field measurement judged on the
video UDP flow from a packet capture.
구현계획.md: C0 note -- stage 1 done, the independent hard cap shipped, stages 2-3 not started.

Product: none. Test: none. Docs: docs/history.md, docs/작업목록.md, docs/구현계획.md (Codex review OK).
